summary: DeepSeek announced general availability of DeepSeek-V4-Pro with agent-focused upgrades, flexible reasoning-effort tiers, native OpenAI Responses API support optimized for Codex, and a new peak/off-peak API pricing schedule effective August 16, 2026.

practices.reason: The release claims agent and reasoning-effort improvements and Codex-optimized tool support, but gives no benchmark figures to confirm the gain, so it merits evaluation before relying on it.
practices.quote: 🔷 Major Agent upgrades with strong production gains!

practices.reason: Native Responses API support with one-click Codex setup changes how a team would wire the model into existing OpenAI-API-based tooling.
practices.quote: 🔷 Native OpenAI Responses API support, optimized for Codex with one-click setup.

practices.reason: The new peak/off-peak pricing tiers create an incentive to reschedule batch or non-interactive workloads to off-peak hours to cut cost.
practices.quote: Off-peak rates are 50% lower than peak, enabling more flexible workload scheduling.
